title: Effect of solvent composition on a one-dimensional (NH4)2V10O25·8H2O electroactive material for electrochemical hydrogen storage application
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22128-22137
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03066H, Paper

Poria Gomrokchi, Maryam Ghiyasiyan-Arani, Elmuez A. Dawi, Forat H. Alsultany, Salman Khalaf Issa, Mehdi Shabani-Nooshabadi, Masoud Salavati-Niasari
The improved electrochemical performance of electrodes based on (NH4)2V10O25·8H2O could be useful for energy storage systems, such as hydrogen-storage systems, when the morphology is 1D owing to poorly conductive vanadium-based materials.
